content./OPPONENTS/0/blurb: Built from smithy scraps, but Old Tom's autocannon never jams.
content./OPPONENTS/1/blurb: A stable quadruped platform with accurate guns; its front scoop can shove you out of the arena.
content./OPPONENTS/2/blurb: The first competitor to mount a side cannon on the side layer, taking potshots from behind armor.
content./OPPONENTS/3/blurb: Its swaying bipedal chassis is extremely hard to hit, and it charges at full speed with a ram.
content./OPPONENTS/4/blurb: Heavy armor rises to the fifth layer, with a lobber on top and a steam hammer at the front.
content./OPPONENTS/5/blurb: A six-layer mobile fortress: five boilers, three side cannons, a top-mounted lobber, and a scoop welded ahead of the tracks.
content./TERRAINS/flat/desc: Level cinder ground with no cover: firepower and armor decide the match.
content./TERRAINS/crates/desc: Wooden crates in the middle can stop a shell or two. Drive into them to crush them, with a brief slowdown; the broken wood also slows vehicles slightly.
content./TERRAINS/mud/desc: A broad patch of mud in the middle: tracked speed ×0.8, quadruped ×0.65, biped ×0.45. Ramming vehicles cannot build up speed in mud.
content./TERRAINS/hills/desc: A central ridge stops low direct-fire shells. Climbing slows you down, descending speeds you up, and crossing vehicles are raised above the ground.
content./TERRAINS/yard/desc: Two small slopes flank tall crates: they stop a few low-flying shells and take extra time to crush through.
content./TERRAINS/mine/desc: A central slag heap with mud pits on both sides: you start in mud and must cross the heap to close in.
content./SIDE_ENCOUNTERS/0/blurb: A patrol outside the docks has stopped the supply vehicle. No spectators or prize money, but their periscope is worth salvaging for study.
content./SIDE_ENCOUNTERS/1/blurb: The escort stays out of tournaments and guards the factory gate. Defeat it to obtain a rare armor plate.

content./SIDE_LINES/0/episodes/0/blurb: The same Soot Widow from the back alley: all parts are now wrought iron, and its two front armor plates are steel.
content./OFFICIAL_BLUEPRINTS/0/desc: A dependable starter build: one direct-fire cannon, with armor protecting the boiler.
content./OFFICIAL_BLUEPRINTS/1/desc: Wide tracks and a front scoop, autocannon suppression, and ramming to shove opponents out.
content./OFFICIAL_BLUEPRINTS/2/desc: Low quadruped dispersion, direct-fire frontal attacks, and a top lobber striking enemy roofs.
content./OFFICIAL_BLUEPRINTS/3/desc: Fast and hard to hit, with a ram welded ahead of the armor. Ideal for close-range charges.
content./CAMPAIGN/0/blurb: Old Tom will teach you to drive a steam war machine. Try the cinder yard: A/D to drive, hold the left mouse button to aim and fire.
content./CAMPAIGN/0/unlock/note: The shop is open: placing a module you do not own on your vehicle buys it. Each large cell divides into 2×2 small cells: small water tanks, tall water tanks, light cannons, vehicle machine guns, and vertical boilers fill gaps and add firepower or power.
content./CAMPAIGN/1/blurb: The back alleys' underground racing circuit. Make your name here before anyone offers you a tournament invitation.
content./ORDERS/0/text: Plowing muddy fields takes four legs and enough water to avoid running dry halfway through.
content./ORDERS/1/text: A bipedal mail carrier must be light: total rated power demand no greater than 60 kW.
content./ORDERS/2/text: The factory needs a strong steam prime mover with plenty of power.
content./ORDERS/3/text: A fire engine must withstand heat: 3 water tanks and 90 seconds at full output without overheating.
content./ORDERS/4/text: The mine tunnels often collapse. We need a sturdy tracked vehicle.
content./ORDERS/5/text: We need a big, intimidating machine: stack it six layers high!

modules./MODULES/track/desc:
Before engineers finally realized they should join rails into a complete loop around the wheels, Mr. Boydell proposed a more belligerent compromise: if the ground would not cooperate with the wheel, the wheel would slap the ground with every step.

"Do not approach the rotating rim without steel-toed boots. It does not care whether it treads on English soil, Russian soil, or some unfortunate assistant's toes."
— Royal Engineering Proving Ground, fragment of the third accident report
modules./MODULES/quad/desc: The steadiest firing platform: stationary dispersion -30%, with almost no sway while moving and firing. Braking is the slowest, with a long slide before stopping.
modules./MODULES/biped/desc: The fastest acceleration, braking, and travel speed. Its swaying gait makes it hard for enemies to hit, but also gives it the greatest dispersion when firing on the move.
modules./MODULES/cockpit/desc: Four drivers cram into one cabin: you control one weapon group, while they aim and fire the other three independently (less accurately than you). Losing every cockpit means defeat.
modules./MODULES/helmet/desc: Calling it a cockpit is mostly a courtesy for the paperwork. It is really an open-air control stand caged in a few riveted metal plates. The enclosure is another concession to appearances: the company dislikes persistently high driver casualty rates.
modules./MODULES/cockpit_pair/desc: A 1×2 shared cockpit for you and Pip. Pip can operate a second weapon; install one and you each control a gun. Unlocks before the four-seat shared cockpit.
modules./MODULES/plate/desc:
Half a metal armor plate, small enough for any smith's forge. Useful for infantry and vehicles alike: the greatest invention of the century! ...One of them!
Er, perhaps it was invented last century? Fine, fine. Either way, like a Slavic countryball stuffing straw into a padded coat, tuck a plate anywhere it fits!
modules./MODULES/tank_s/desc: A water tank to quench the boiler's thirst, fashionably made with glass. Fine craftsmanship makes it surprisingly sturdy, and its low price puts one in every London home. It can quench the driver's thirst, too.
modules./MODULES/tank_tall/desc: A slender, upright metal cylinder made to fill awkward gaps. Its 75 L capacity is not lavish, but enough for everyday use. It keeps the engine sane and gives workers somewhere excellent to hang their washing.
modules./MODULES/copilot/desc: Removed; incorporated into the shared cockpit.
modules./MODULES/armor/desc: Metal plating used across countless trades, and one of the culprits behind rising metal prices. It protects larger areas, but its weight is no small concern.
modules./MODULES/armor_heavy/desc: Twice as thick, with armor 6: autocannons barely scratch it. Also more than twice as heavy, using chassis capacity and slowing the vehicle.
modules./MODULES/cannon/desc: A low-trajectory cannon. Elevation is only -8°~30°, so targets too high or close are out of reach. Shell dispersion sometimes sends shots wide. No friendly modules may be ahead in the same row. Available from wrought iron onward.
modules./MODULES/cannon_m/desc: A horizontal 2×1 main gun occupying just one row. No friendly modules may be ahead of it. Lighter and cheaper than the direct-fire cannon, with somewhat lower damage.
modules./MODULES/cannon_s/desc: A cheap, low-power light cannon occupying one small cell. Turns early-build gaps into a second firing position.
modules./MODULES/cannon_heavy/desc: An oversized cannon available from nickel-plated material onward. High damage and power demand; occupies three columns and two rows horizontally, requiring a clear muzzle path ahead.
modules./MODULES/cannon_giant/desc: A siege mortar captured from Queen Victoria. Lobs shells over friendly armor onto enemy roofs. Slow reload and traverse; can lob at nearby targets ahead. Has the greatest heat and power demands.
modules./MODULES/mortar/desc:
Today's arcing artillery has grown considerably in both power and dispersion. Weight and price have followed suit. Inventors keep trying to turn it into a rapid urban commuting device, with fierce technological competition every day.

"Ith a fine job, very exthiting, freeth your thoughtth from the earth... Can I have my medical money now?" — A battered test operator
modules./MODULES/mg/desc: Rapid fire with low damage, best against unarmored boilers, tanks, and cockpits; armor only sparks. Its forward firing path must also be clear.
modules./MODULES/side_cannon/desc: Mounts on the side layer and can hide behind armor, firing without friendly obstruction. Its swaying barrel causes considerable dispersion.
modules./MODULES/pressure_tank/descTemplate: Steam accumulator: stores steam energy when power is plentiful and supplies up to {BATTLE.STORE_RELEASE_PER_SEC} kW during shortages. Capacity 1000 kJ; explodes if destroyed while more than half full.
modules./MODULES/pressure_chamber/desc: A small-cell pressure unit supplying 20 kW shaft power, about 27.2 metric horsepower; includes 8 L cooling water and 55 kW rated circuit waste heat.
modules./MODULES/radiator/desc: An open-grille radiator that mounts outside the main body once the side layer unlocks. Stores no water, but increases continuous heat dissipation.
modules./MODULES/condenser/descTemplate: Condenser: vehicle-wide cooling water consumption ×0.7 (multiple units stack multiplicatively, minimum ×{WATER_SAVE_MIN}); stores no water itself.
modules./MODULES/rocket_rack/desc: Four-shot volley launcher: lower tiers throw bombs; higher tiers use compressed air and rocket assistance. All shots arc over frontal cover. Each deals 14 damage with splash within 24px, reload 6 s. Explodes if destroyed while reloading.
modules./MODULES/harpoon/desc: Reels in the enemy after a hit for up to 4 s. Better materials give stronger ropes. When surplus pulling power exceeds rope strength, greater and longer overload makes breakage more likely. Cannot fire again while connected.
modules./MODULES/flamer/desc: T4～T6 flamethrower: range 170px, continuous ±10° flame cone; transfers 300 kW heat to enemy machinery and deals 4/s continuous damage to hit modules. Generates 150 kW circuit heat itself.
modules./MODULES/steamjet/desc: T1～T3 steam jet: range 170px, ±10° steam cone, rated shaft power 20 kW. Continuous spraying transfers 200 kW heat to enemies and generates 75 kW itself. Stored water is only for cooling. Steel is the highest material tier.
modules./MODULES/boss_core/descTemplate: The Ironclad Sanctuary's pressure core: 50 kW shaft power, 400 kJ stored steam energy, 24 L water, and 150 kW rated water cooling. Releases up to {BATTLE.STORE_RELEASE_PER_SEC} kW from storage; circuit waste heat ×0.9. Boss loot.
modules./MODULES/boss_lens/desc: The Brass Duke's rangefinding prism: faster, steadier aiming for the whole vehicle. Boss loot.
modules./MODULES/boss_ram/desc: The Soot Widow's modified hydraulic ram combines collision damage with short-cycle piston strikes. Boss loot.
modules./MODULES/boiler/desc: Rated output 60 kW shaft power, about 81.6 metric horsepower; full-load steam thermal power 500 kW. Stored water is used only for cooling, not power generation. Explodes when destroyed, damaging adjacent modules.
modules./MODULES/water/desc: Rated water cooling 200 kW when the machinery circuit is 30°C above ambient; evaporating each 1 L of water removes about 2257 kJ of heat.
modules./MODULES/bucket/desc: A coal-shoveling tool whimsically attached to a vehicle. Unconventional, but unless you want to be scooped away like a lump of coal, pay attention... Full concentration might be the better phrase.
modules./MODULES/spike/desc: A solid steel ram mounted directly ahead of armor or chassis, much heavier than a scoop. Chassis-mounted rams can reach enemy tracks and legs. Damage rises sharply with impact speed and vehicle mass; full-speed charges hit hardest.
modules./MODULES/piston/desc: Mounts directly ahead of armor or chassis. At close range, its steam piston strikes every 1.5 s, regardless of speed.
modules./MODULES/mortar_s/desc: Arcing artillery widely used since Napoleon's day, gradually retired by armies for its unusual trajectory and dispersion. Now popular in vehicle combat, circus shows, playing fetch with dogs, and private commercial short-haul flights.
modules./MODULES/mg2/desc: Two machine guns combined into one module, with fast reload and high power consumption, firing as a single volley group.
modules./MODULES/periscope/desc: Physical support module: vehicle-wide aiming speed +0.25 and fully charged aim-circle tightening +0.1. Stops working when destroyed.
modules./MODULES/autoloader/desc: Side-mounts on compatible weapons of at least 1×2: only that weapon's reload time ×0.85. Stops working when destroyed.
modules./MODULES/rangefinder/desc: Physical support module: direct-fire weapon dispersion ×0.85. Stops working when destroyed.
modules./MODULES/gyroscope/desc: Physical support module: vehicle-wide body sway ×0.7. Stops working when destroyed.
modules./MODULES/mg_s/desc: Made to meet cheap novice training needs (and compulsive gap-filling). Limited damage and penetration per shot, but impressively loud: excellent if all you want is noise. Many veterans need its sound to sleep peacefully.
modules./MODULES/mg_heavy/desc: An upright heavy machine gun occupying 1×2 small cells. More damage and penetration than the vehicle machine gun, but needs more power.
modules./MODULES/boiler_s/desc: Small though it is, it squeezes out 40 horsepower! Compared with the other hulking machines, it seems gentle and adorable. Its one little flaw: no room left for a safety valve. Keep the cockpit away unless you are very agile.
modules./MODULES/boiler_l/desc: A large boiler occupying 3×3 small cells, supplying 135 kW shaft power, about 183.5 metric horsepower. Stored water is only for cooling, not power generation. High weight, waste heat, and explosion risk.
modules./MODULES/water_l/desc: Occupies 3×3 small cells, stores 340 L water, rated water cooling 450 kW. Suits large war machines that need sustained fire.
modules./MODULES/mech_helm/desc: A two-cell-wide mech helmet: the helmet itself occupies the central cell, with an integral forged neck guard and shoulder plates on both sides. Seats one driver, but is much tougher than a cockpit of the same size and includes armor. Biped-only; knight modifications can improve durability further.
modules./MODULES/leg_spring/desc: Lower-leg attachment for true bipeds; required for jumping and disabled when destroyed. Its mass affects physics without using hip load capacity.
modules./MODULES/leg_booster/desc: Hip attachment for true bipeds, increasing base and top speed by 12%; does not use hip load capacity.
modules./MODULES/knight_shield/desc: A physical shield arm covering the vehicle body, blocking shells with its own durability. Durability increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./MODULES/knight_fist/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./MODULES/knight_hammer/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./MODULES/knight_sword/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./MODULES/knight_cannon/desc: Side-mounted arm weapon covering the vehicle body; damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./MODULES/knight_gun/desc: Side-mounted arm weapon covering the vehicle body; damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./INGOTS/wootz/desc: Indian crucible steel with flowing patterns. Upgrading a nickel-plated module to Epic Wootz Steel requires 1 ingot.
modules./INGOTS/aether/desc: A glowing crystal taken from Queen Victoria's boiler. Upgrading a Wootz Steel module to Legendary Aether Alloy requires 1 crystal.

modules./factory/MODULES/mech_helm/desc: A two-cell-wide mech helmet: the helmet itself occupies the central cell, with an integral forged neck guard and shoulder plates on both sides. Seats one driver, but is much tougher than a cockpit of the same size and includes armor. Biped-only; knight modifications can improve durability further.
modules./factory/MODULES/leg_spring/desc: Lower-leg attachment for true bipeds; required for jumping and disabled when destroyed. Its mass affects physics without using hip load capacity.
modules./factory/MODULES/leg_booster/desc: Hip attachment for true bipeds, increasing base and top speed by 12%; does not use hip load capacity.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_shield/desc: A physical shield arm covering the vehicle body, blocking shells with its own durability. Durability increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_fist/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_hammer/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_sword/desc: Side-mounted melee arm that strikes at close range on cooldown; strike damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_cannon/desc: Side-mounted arm weapon covering the vehicle body; damage increases 40% on bipeds.
modules./factory/MODULES/knight_gun/desc: Side-mounted arm weapon covering the vehicle body; damage increases 40% on bipeds.

stage-cars./records/0:0/blurb: A practice vehicle built from scrap, with just one machine gun and terrible aim.
stage-cars./records/0:0/unlock/note: Workshop unlocked: your inventory contains one machine gun and two iron armor plates, plus a small water tank to practice cooling.
stage-cars./records/0:1/blurb: An armor plate is welded above the cockpit. See what it protects, then try firing through a weak spot.
stage-cars./records/0:1/unlock/note: Armor plate acquired: return to the workshop and mount it on the side where vital components are taking fire.
stage-cars./records/0:2/blurb: Old Tom's autocannon never jams and targets your unarmored boiler and cockpit. His front scoop will shove you out. Protect your vital components with armor, then close in.
stage-cars./records/0:2/unlock/note: Scoop captured: when aiming is difficult early on, use your engine power and scoop to close in and finish the fight.
stage-cars./records/1:0/blurb: Its front is covered in iron plating; autocannon hits only spark (armor reduces damage per shot). Punch through with a direct-fire cannon, then target its gun.
stage-cars./records/1:0/unlock/note: Street matches and the bank unlocked: earn your modification budget in short matches, then decide whether to spend it on weapons or cooling.
stage-cars./records/1:1/blurb: Two autocannons sweep high and low, and it moves fast, targeting unarmored modules. Hide your boiler and cockpit behind armor and close in to attack.
stage-cars./records/1:1/unlock/note: Periscope and autoloader unlocked: mount them to improve aiming and reloading. Their effects disappear when destroyed.
stage-cars./records/1:2/blurb: [Rival] Martha has replaced the front of her quadruped gun platform with heavy armor. Top and side cannons fire down from above, while the front scoop can still shove you out. She says the back alley has room for only one of you.
stage-cars./records/1:2/unlock/note: Side cannon and heavy armor captured: side-mounted weapons fire from outside your armor, while heavy armor makes frontal pushing collisions less costly.
stage-cars./records/1:3/blurb: The first wrought-iron vehicle: tough at the front, exposed on top. Its direct-fire cannon cannot aim low enough to hit you at point-blank range.
stage-cars./records/1:3/weakness: Hit its roof with a side cannon, or get right up close.
stage-cars./records/1:4/blurb: Charges with wide tracks and a scoop, with a light mortar at the rear.
stage-cars./records/1:4/weakness: Let mud slow it down, then lob shells from behind crates.
stage-cars./records/1:5/blurb: Its swaying bipedal gait makes it hard to hit; it charges at full speed with a ram.
stage-cars./records/1:5/weakness: Wait until its charge brings it close, then fire. Its armor is thin.
stage-cars./records/1:6/blurb: Heavy armor up front + two mortars at the rear + a two-seat cockpit.
stage-cars./records/1:6/weakness: Trade shots over the roof with a light mortar; rush a biped into the mortars' close-range blind spot; or wear it down with a side cannon behind heavy armor.
stage-cars./records/2:0/blurb: Two layers of heavy armor sit behind a wall; steam pushes you away at close range.
stage-cars./records/2:0/weakness: Push the wall aside with a ram.
stage-cars./records/2:1/blurb: A fast biped sprays steam at point-blank range; your heat rises faster than your health drops.
stage-cars./records/2:1/weakness: Control heat with radiators and condensers, then hit and run.
stage-cars./records/2:2/blurb: A quadruped keeps its distance behind a slope, using a harpoon to drag you into its steam cone.
stage-cars./records/2:2/weakness: Destroy the harpoon first; stay beyond 760px and use direct or arcing fire; or fit a front ram so being pulled in lets you strike.
stage-cars./records/2:3/blurb: A sluggish cotton carrier that only fires its autocannons from a distance.
stage-cars./records/2:3/weakness: Pull it in with a harpoon, then ram it.
stage-cars./records/2:4/blurb: Steel front armor + a ram. Ramming it head-on will shatter your own collision module through recoil.
stage-cars./records/2:4/weakness: Destroy its ram first, or reinforce your own impact surface.

values.story:opening: [{"text":"London's spring is harsh and unforgiving; cold wind drives through the door cracks like nails. Like countless ordinary people, you have left home with nothing to your name.","scene":"sleep"},{"text":"As you wander through your family's kitchen in a dream, the roof of your shack is suddenly torn away—","scene":"roof"},{"text":"A Distant Relative you have not seen for ages tumbles in... followed by your landlord, the Blacksmith.","scene":"roll"},{"text":"For the Queen's birthday! Take over my war machine and win glory!","who":"uncle","scene":"car"},{"text":"...And prize money!","who":"smith"},{"text":"What are these people doing here? Before you can think it through, you are pushed into the vehicle."}]
values.story:tutorial.intro: [{"text":"The Queen's birthday is almost here, and the grand tournament held once a decade is about to begin. We must train quickly to reach the arena on the day of her birthday banquet.","who":"uncle"},{"text":"I've brought my apprentice Pip to spar with you!","who":"smith"},{"text":"Seriously, why did they take it upon themselves to push you into the vehicle? Er... perhaps you owe a lot of rent? Or perhaps your relative sent a letter that you threw away."},{"text":"Whatever the reason, your new life has begun!"}]
values.story:tutorial.parts.0: [{"text":"Cockpit: the heart of everything. Lose it and you lose the match.","who":"uncle"}]
values.story:tutorial.parts.1: [{"text":"Tracks: the finest invention of this century."},{"text":"...The last century.","who":"smith"}]
values.story:tutorial.parts.2: [{"text":"Boiler: the heart of everything. Lose it and you lose the match.","who":"uncle"},{"text":"...Did I just say that already?","who":"uncle"},{"text":"Yes, you senile old fool.","who":"smith"}]
values.story:tutorial.parts.3: [{"text":"Machine gun: don't worry, these are training rounds!","who":"uncle"},{"text":"\"Are you sure?!\""},{"text":"You try to shout, but the engine's roar drowns you out. You fervently hope your relative's senility was not speaking for him."}]
values.story:before.0,2: [{"text":"Oh—old man, your young friend really has some skill! My turn now!","who":"smith"}]
values.story:feat.garage: [{"text":"You can now use the workshop, for the glory of Britain's Queen!","who":"uncle"},{"text":"We need a good vehicle.","who":"uncle"},{"text":"Then why is yours such a wreck?","who":"smith"},{"text":"It's a long story... a long story...","who":"uncle"}]
values.story:feat.pip_pair: [{"text":"The two-seat cockpit is installed, and Pip is already inside.","who":"smith"},{"text":"Time for you and Pip to fight together!","who":"uncle"},{"text":"Pip can operate a second weapon. Install another and you can each control one.","who":"smith"}]
values.story:feat.shop: [{"text":"The shop is open: you can buy new parts straight from Old Tom. For money, of course...","who":"uncle"},{"text":"What a miser. (Quietly.)","who":"uncle"},{"text":"You still owe me money!","who":"smith"}]
values.story:feat.bank: [{"text":"Oh! What's this? Account details for the Bank of London. Now you can borrow money!","who":"uncle"},{"text":"Then what about my debts...","who":"smith"},{"text":"Oh! My memory! Time for a drink!","who":"uncle"}]
values.story:feat.side: ["The side layer is unlocked: you can mount parts on the sides of the vehicle."]

values.story:tutorial.controls.move.touch: [{"text":"Use the ring on the left to move forward and backward."}]

values.story:guide.arena: [{"text":"This blackboard is your battle station. The schedule is chalked on the left: finished matches are crossed out, and the next one is circled."},{"text":"The match poster is in the middle; your opponent's profile is on the right. Check their rating and speed before you fight."},{"text":"The battle lever is at the bottom right. Hold its handle and push it all the way right to fight, or all the way left to return to the yard."},{"text":"To modify your vehicle, click the Workshop sign at the bottom left."}]
values.story:guide.arena.lever: [{"text":"Try it: hold the lever at the bottom right and push it all the way right—battle!"}]
values.story:guide.garage: [{"text":"This is the workshop. Your vehicle sits on the workbench in the middle; every cell can hold a part."},{"text":"The parts list is on the right. Your new small water tank is there."}]
values.story:guide.garage.tank: [{"text":"Install the tank: hold it in the list, drag it into an empty vehicle cell, and release. Or click the tank first, then click the cell."}]
values.story:guide.stats: [{"text":"Installed! The stat sheet on the left changes with your build. Let's look at each item:"}]
values.story:guide.stats.rating: [{"text":"Rating: roughly how strong the whole vehicle is. Compare it with your opponent's profile before fighting."}]
values.story:guide.stats.power: [{"text":"Power: steam supplied by the boiler versus steam needed for equipment and driving. If the bar passes the red line, the vehicle cannot move and weapons slow down."}]
values.story:guide.stats.weight: [{"text":"Weight: the whole vehicle with full water tanks. The red line is chassis load capacity; exceed it and you cannot drive. More weight means harder impacts, but slower starts and climbing."}]
values.story:guide.stats.speed: [{"text":"Speed: top speed on flat ground. Insufficient power reduces it."}]
values.story:guide.stats.heat: [{"text":"Heat: heat generation versus cooling at full firepower. At 100%, continued firing makes you hotter; overheating forces boiler depressurization and stops weapons."}]
values.story:guide.stats.water: [{"text":"Water: cooling water in the tanks carries heat away. When it runs dry, only the radiators remain. Your new tank adds to this item."}]
values.story:guide.stats.exit: [{"text":"Hover over each item briefly to see the detailed figures. Once your vehicle is ready, click Battle → below to go to the blackboard."}]
values.story:guide.shop: [{"text":"The shop is open! A Shop switch now appears above the parts list."},{"text":"Switch to Shop to see available parts with their prices; switch back to see only your inventory."}]
values.story:before.5,2: [{"text":"The eve of the birthday. A tea cart slips into the smithy's yard, with a large teapot hanging from its roof."},{"text":"Harrington's butler! He's trying to pour sugar into your boiler!","who":"uncle"},{"text":"(Picks up a hammer.) In my yard?","who":"smith"}]
values.story:stage.5,2.win: [{"text":"The butler raises a white handkerchief: \"Sir Harrington instructed me... merely to deliver a box of biscuits.\""},{"text":"...Leave the biscuits. Get out.","who":"smith"},{"text":"The final is tomorrow. On Queen Victoria's main boiler, the last weld is crooked—that's my signature. Hit it.","who":"smith"},{"text":"Which side? Left or right?","who":"uncle"},{"text":"...Just hit the boiler.","who":"smith"}]
